payout_quote: Initial Deposit Amount | Rewards: $500+ -> 20 Free Fractional Shares; $100 - $499.99 -> 3 Free Fractional Shares. Each share is valued between $3 - $3,000. (Official FAQ) Initial Deposit Bonus Promotion: $3-$3000 per share. You have 30 days to claim your free stock... deposited into your Webull brokerage account within 15 business days after the date you claimed... you can sell the free stock once it has settled... proceeds can be used to invest in other stocks or withdrawn as funds.
timing: Claim reward within 30 days; shares deposited within 15 business days after claiming; sellable after settlement, proceeds withdrawable
eligibility: New Webull brokerage customers (never previously funded a Webull account); US residents; initial deposit of $100+; KYC/SSN required for brokerage account
steps: Make an initial deposit of $100 or more (any $100-$499.99 tier)
Claim the 3 free fractional shares in Menu -> My Rewards within 30 days
Shares arrive within 15 business days; sell after settlement
Withdraw the proceeds as cash or keep invested
catches: The 3 shares are RANDOMLY selected fractional shares worth $3-$3,000 each - most people land near the $9 minimum; treat this like a lottery ticket, not $9,000.
You must deposit $100 of your own money into a brokerage account (you can withdraw your deposit, but it must stay long enough to fund/settle).
Shares take up to 15 business days to arrive after you claim; you must claim within 30 days or lose them.
Brokerage account requires SSN and identity verification - this is a real securities account, not a signup form.
Reward shares are taxable income and may be reported on Form 1099.
Higher tiers ($500+ deposit for 20 shares) exist but tie up more of your own money for the same random odds.
biggest_catch: You deposit $100 of real money and get 3 random fractional shares worth $3-$3,000 each - statistically you'll get about $9, not the headline 'up to 75 free shares'; and you can't touch them until weeks later.
